```{r}
res_mark_run4 <- read.table("../data/QC/Input/run4/resistance_marker_module/resmarker_table_by_locus.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)

res_mark_run4$SampleID <- gsub("_S.*","",res_mark_run4$SampleID)

res_mark_run4 <- res_mark_run4 %>% 
  group_by(SampleID, Gene, CodonID,RefAA, AA,AARefAlt) %>%
  mutate(Reads = sum(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-Locus,-GeneID,-RefCodon,-Codon,-CodonRefAlt) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Gene, CodonID) %>% 
  mutate(Read_locus = sum(Reads)) %>% 
  filter(Read_locus > 10) %>% 
  filter(Reads >= 5) %>% 
  ungroup()

res_mark_combined <- rbind(res_mark_run4,res_mark_run5,res_mark_run9) %>% 
  filter(!grepl("3D7", SampleID)) %>%
  select(SampleID, Gene, CodonID, RefAA, AA, AARefAlt, Reads) %>% 
  group_by(SampleID, Gene, CodonID,RefAA, AA,AARefAlt) %>%
  mutate(Reads = sum(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct()



res_mark_both_run <- res_mark_combined %>%
  mutate(AA_Change = paste0(RefAA,CodonID)) %>% 
  group_by(SampleID, Gene, CodonID) %>%
  mutate(
    total_read = sum(Reads),
    alt_read = sum(ifelse(AARefAlt == "ALT", Reads, 0)),
    ref_read = sum(ifelse(AARefAlt == "REF", Reads, 0)),
    has_alt = any(AARefAlt == "ALT"),
    has_ref = any(AARefAlt == "REF"),
    VAF = case_when(
      has_alt & !has_ref ~ 100,
      has_ref & !has_alt ~ 0,
      has_alt & has_ref ~ round((alt_read / total_read) * 100, 2),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !(VAF >= 95 & AARefAlt == "REF"),  # remove REF if ALT dominates
    !(VAF <= 5 & AARefAlt == "ALT")    # remove ALT if REF dominates
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-total_read,-alt_read,-ref_read,-has_alt,-has_ref) %>% 
  mutate(VAF_ = paste0(RefAA,CodonID,"_VAF")) %>% 
  mutate(VAF = as.character(VAF))



piv <- function(df){
  df <- df %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = AA_Change, values_from = AA, values_fill = "NA") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = VAF_, values_from = VAF, values_fill = "NA")
  return(df)
}



return_non_NA <- function(column) {
  # Remove NA values from the column
  non_na_values <- column[column != "NA"]
  # Check conditions and return the appropriate value
  if (length(non_na_values) == 0) {
    return(NA) }
  else if (length(non_na_values) == 1) {
    return(non_na_values[1]) }
  else {
    return(paste(non_na_values, collapse = "/"))
   }
  }


row_merge_aa <- function(df){
  df <- df %>% 
  select(-CodonID) %>% 
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  reframe(
    Gene = first(Gene),
    across(all_of(grep("[A-Z][0-9].*", names(df), value = TRUE)), return_non_NA))
  
}

sort_col <- function(df){
  # Get column names
  col_names <- colnames(df)
  
  # Extract columns matching the pattern
  pattern_cols <- str_subset(col_names, "^[a-zA-Z][0-9]+?")
  
  # Extract numeric part for sorting
  numeric_part <- str_extract(pattern_cols, "\\d+")
  
  # Order pattern columns based on the numeric part
  sorted_pattern_cols <- pattern_cols[order(as.numeric(numeric_part))]
  
  # Combine sorted pattern columns with others
  sorted_col_names <- c(setdiff(col_names, pattern_cols),sorted_pattern_cols)
  
  # Reorder the dataframe based on the sorted column names
  df_sorted <- df %>%
    select(all_of(sorted_col_names))
      return(df_sorted)
}


# Function to concatenate values with specific conditions
concat_values <- function(df) {
  # Initialize an empty vector to store concatenated values
  concatenated_values <- vector("character", nrow(df))
  
  # Loop over each row
  for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    # # Get the values excluding the first two columns
    # row_values <- df[i, -c(1, 2)]
    
    # Get column indices to exclude
    exclude_cols <- c(1, 2, which(grepl("_VAF$", names(df))))
    
    # Filter the row, excluding those columns
    row_values <- df[i, -exclude_cols]

    # Substitute NA with "-"
    row_values[is.na(row_values)] <- "-"
    
    # First round: take single letters or the first letter before '_'
    first_round <- sapply(row_values, function(value) {
      if (grepl("/", value)) {
        return(substring(value, 1, 1))
      } else {
        return(value)
      }
    })
    
    # Second round: take single letters or the second letter after '_'
    second_round <- sapply(row_values, function(value) {
      if (grepl("/", value)) {
        return(substring(value, nchar(value), nchar(value)))
      } else {
        return(value)
      }
    })
     if (paste(first_round, collapse = "/") == paste(second_round, collapse = "/")){
       concatenated_values[i] <- paste(first_round, collapse = "/")
     }else{
       # Concatenate both rounds with "/" and separate them by "-"
    concatenated_values[i] <- paste(paste(first_round, collapse = "/"), paste(second_round, collapse = "/"), sep = "-")
     }
    
  }
  
  # Add the concatenated values as a new column in the data frame
  df$Microhaplotype <- concatenated_values
  
  return(df)
}


clean_VAF_columns <- function(df) {
  vaf_cols <- grep("_VAF$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  
  df[vaf_cols] <- lapply(df[vaf_cols], function(col) {
    if (is.factor(col)) col <- as.character(col)  # Ensure character
    sub("/.*", "", col)  # Remove '/' and everything after
  })
  
  return(df)
}

# assigns mutation status for the haplotype
get_mutation_type <- function(row, cols) {
  values <- as.character(row[cols])
  col_initials <- substr(cols, 1, 1)
  
  if (all(values == "-")) return("NA")
  if (any(grepl("/", values))) return("mixed")
  
  is_wild <- mapply(function(val, init) val == init, values, col_initials)
  is_na <- values == "-"
  is_mutant <- mapply(function(val, init) val != init & val != "-", values, col_initials)
  
  if (all(is_wild)) return("wildtype")
  if (any(is_wild) & any(is_na) & !any(is_mutant)) return("NA")
  if (any(is_mutant)) return("mutant")
  
  return("NA")
}

#assign mutation status for snps
get_snp_status <- function(df, cols) {
  for (col in cols) {
    ref_aa <- substr(col, 1, 1)  # first letter of col name is the reference AA
    new_col <- paste0(col, "_status")
    
    df[[new_col]] <- sapply(df[[col]], function(val) {
      if (val == "-") {
        return("NA")
      } else if (grepl("/", val)) {
        return("mixed")
      } else if (val == ref_aa) {
        return("wildtype")
      } else {
        return("mutant")
      }
    })
  }
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}

snp_summary <- read_csv("../data/Resistance_Markers/TES_mutlitsite_resmarker_haplotype_summary_5%101725.csv")
  # mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ifelse(is.na(.) |. == "-", "NA", as.character(.))))

construct_haplotype_fixed <- function(df, snps) {
  # --- Group SNPs by gene ---
  genes <- unique(sub(".*_", "", snps))
  gene_groups <- split(snps, sub(".*_", "", snps))
  
  # Function to extract clean allele options (split mixed, handle NA)
  parse_alleles <- function(a) {
    if (is.na(a) || a == "NA" || a == "-") return("-")
    if (grepl("/", a)) strsplit(a, "/")[[1]] else a
  }
  
  # Function to get consistent haplotypes for one gene
  get_gene_haplotypes <- function(allele_vec) {
    alleles_split <- lapply(allele_vec, parse_alleles)
    n_pos <- length(alleles_split)
    
    # If all missing, return "-"
    if (all(sapply(alleles_split, function(x) all(x == "-")))) return("-")
    
    # Count how many positions have multiple alleles
    mix_positions <- which(sapply(alleles_split, length) > 1)
    
    # If no mixed positions, single haplotype
    if (length(mix_positions) == 0) {
      return(paste0(sapply(alleles_split, `[`, 1), collapse = ""))
    }
    
    # Ensure consistent mixed haplotypes (not all permutations)
    n_haps <- max(sapply(alleles_split, length))
    
    haplotypes <- character(n_haps)
    for (h in seq_len(n_haps)) {
      hap <- sapply(seq_len(n_pos), function(i) {
        alleles <- alleles_split[[i]]
        if (length(alleles) == 1) {
          alleles
        } else {
          # Alternate across possible alleles
          alleles[(h - 1) %% length(alleles) + 1]
        }
      })
      haplotypes[h] <- paste0(hap, collapse = "")
    }
    unique(haplotypes)
  }
  
  # Function to determine haplotype mutation status
  get_status <- function(status_vec) {
    status_vec <- as.character(status_vec)
    status_vec[status_vec == ""]   <- NA_character_
    status_vec[status_vec == "NA"] <- NA_character_
    
    if (any(status_vec == "mixed", na.rm = TRUE)) return("mixed")
    if (any(status_vec == "mutant", na.rm = TRUE)) return("mutant")
    non_na <- status_vec[!is.na(status_vec)]
    
    if (length(non_na) == 0) return("NA")
    if (all(non_na == "wildtype")) {
      if (any(is.na(status_vec))) return("NA")
      return("wildtype")
    }
    return("NA")
  }
  
  haplo_data <- list()
  haplo_status <- list()
  
  # --- Construct haplotypes per gene ---
  for (gene in names(gene_groups)) {
    snp_cols <- gene_groups[[gene]]
    snp_status_cols <- paste0(sub("_.*", "", snp_cols), "_status")
    
    haplo_data[[gene]] <- apply(df[snp_cols], 1, get_gene_haplotypes)
    haplo_status[[gene]] <- apply(df[snp_status_cols], 1, get_status)
  }
  
  # --- Combine across genes ---
  if (length(gene_groups) == 1) {
    gene <- names(gene_groups)
    haplo_colname <- paste0("Pf", gene)
    
    df[[haplo_colname]] <- sapply(haplo_data[[gene]], function(h) paste(h, collapse = "|"))
    df[[paste0(haplo_colname, "_status")]] <- haplo_status[[gene]]
    
  } else {
    all_genes <- names(gene_groups)
    combined_haplos <- vector("list", nrow(df))
    
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
      combos <- haplo_data[[all_genes[1]]][[i]]
      for (g in all_genes[-1]) {
        next_gene_haps <- haplo_data[[g]][[i]]
        combos <- as.vector(outer(combos, next_gene_haps, paste, sep = "/"))
      }
      combined_haplos[[i]] <- paste(unique(combos), collapse = "|")
    }
    
    haplo_colname <- paste0("Pf", paste(all_genes, collapse = "_"))
    df[[haplo_colname]] <- unlist(combined_haplos)
    
    combined_status <- apply(as.data.frame(haplo_status), 1, get_status)
    df[[paste0(haplo_colname, "_status")]] <- combined_status
  }
  
  return(df)
}

# Function to canonicalize mixed haplotypes with optional wildtype first
normalize_haplotypes <- function(haplo_col, sep = "|", wt_haplo = NULL) {
  sapply(haplo_col, function(h) {
    # Split mixed haplotypes
    parts <- unlist(strsplit(h, split = sep, fixed = TRUE))
    # Remove duplicates and empty strings
    parts <- unique(parts[!is.na(parts) & parts != ""])
    
    # Sort alphabetically
    parts_sorted <- sort(parts)
    
    # If a wildtype haplotype is provided and present, place it first
    if (!is.null(wt_haplo) && wt_haplo %in% parts_sorted) {
      parts_sorted <- c(wt_haplo, setdiff(parts_sorted, wt_haplo))
    }
    
    # Recombine into string
    paste(parts_sorted, collapse = sep)
  })
}

dhfr_dhps4 <- construct_haplotype_fixed(snp_summary, snps_dhfr_dhps4) %>%
  select(1,(ncol(.)-1):ncol(.))
dhfr_dhps4$Pfdhfr_dhps <- normalize_haplotypes(dhfr_dhps4$Pfdhfr_dhps, sep = "|", wt_haplo = "NCSI/AK")

k13 <- construct_haplotype_fixed(snp_summary, snps_k13) %>%
  select(1,(ncol(.)-1):ncol(.))
k13$Pfk13 <- normalize_haplotypes(k13$Pfk13, sep = "|", wt_haplo = "ARA")

k131 <- construct_haplotype_fixed(snp_summary, snps_k131) %>%
  select(1,(ncol(.)-1):ncol(.))
k131$Pfk13 <- normalize_haplotypes(k131$Pfk13, sep = "|", wt_haplo = "RA")

mdr1 <- construct_haplotype_fixed(snp_summary, snps_mdr1) %>%
  select(1,(ncol(.)-1):ncol(.))
mdr1$Pfmdr1 <- normalize_haplotypes(mdr1$Pfmdr1, sep = "|", wt_haplo = "NYSND")






hap <- list(crt,dhfr,dhfr2,dhfr3,dhps,dhps1,dhfr_dhps,dhfr_dhps1,dhfr_dhps2,dhfr_dhps3,dhfr_dhps4,k13,k131,mdr1)

merged_df <- reduce(hap, full_join, by = "SampleID") %>% 
  rename("Pfdhfr(sextuple)"="Pfdhfr.x", "Pfdhfr_status(sextuple)"="Pfdhfr_status.x", "Pfdhfr(quadruple)" = "Pfdhfr.y", "Pfdhfr_status(quadruple)"="Pfdhfr_status.y", "Pfdhfr(triple)" = "Pfdhfr", "Pfdhfr_status(triple)" = "Pfdhfr_status", "Pfdhps(sextuple)" = "Pfdhps.x", "Pfdhps_status(sextuple)"="Pfdhps_status.x", "Pfdhps(quintuple)" ="Pfdhps.y", "Pfdhps_status(quintuple)"="Pfdhps_status.y", "Pfdhfr_dhps(quadruple)"="Pfdhfr_dhps.x", "Pfdhfr_dhps_status(quadruple)"="Pfdhfr_dhps_status.x", "Pfdhfr_dhps(quintuple)"="Pfdhfr_dhps.y", "Pfdhfr_dhps_status(quintuple)" = "Pfdhfr_dhps_status.y", "Pfdhfr_dhps(sextuple)"="Pfdhfr_dhps.x.x", "Pfdhfr_dhps_status(sextuple)"="Pfdhfr_dhps_status.x.x", "Pfdhfr_dhps(septuple)"="Pfdhfr_dhps.y.y", "Pfdhfr_dhps_status(septuple)"="Pfdhfr_dhps_status.y.y", "Pfdhfr_dhps(sextuple)1" = "Pfdhfr_dhps", "Pfdhfr_dhps_status(sextuple)1"="Pfdhfr_dhps_status", "Pfk13_622_675" ="Pfk13.y", "Pfk13_status_622_675"="Pfk13_status.y")

write_csv(merged_df,"../data/Resistance_Markers/TES_mutlitsite_resmarker_report.csv")
```
